purpose.summary: ORCS01 is a patient co-payment (負担金) calculation subroutine for the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) medical billing system used in Japan. It computes patient out-of-pocket charges under various Japanese health insurance schemes (elderly care, national health insurance, workers' accident, etc.), handling complex rules for co-payment ratios, upper-limit amounts, rounding, and regional public expense supplements. It is part of a larger open-source medical receipt (レセプト) processing system.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

notable_features: Extremely large single-file COBOL program (~1.47 MB, ~29,000 lines)
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1 artifacts)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure COBOL batch calculation logic
No COMP-3 usage despite heavy arithmetic — unusual for IBM mainframe style
90 CALL statements indicating modular architecture with many subroutines
683 PERFORM statements reflecting complex nested calculation logic
Long revision history spanning 2000–2008 with 100+ named revisions
Open-source JMA ORCA project (JMA Open Source License)
verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the Japanese comments are EUC-JP encoded, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly genuine production COBOL from the well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system ORCA. The absence of COMP-3 and the Linux target strongly suggest GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL rather than IBM Enterprise COBOL. The source is truncated at 16,000 chars but the structural indicators confirm all four divisions are present.
